'''Tekkag''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] she resided inside [[Gorma-Koss]] in the [[Gormak Lands]] beyond [[Outpost Skyline]], where she was attacked and killed by an Imperial.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Tekkag appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the mission "Gormak War Camps" on Voss.
